about: Every package that may appear in package-lock.json, with why it is there. The gate fails on any name that is not listed, and on any listed name that is no longer used. A trailing * covers one family of platform builds published together with their parent. goModules: every Go module engine/go.mod may require, the same way.

packages.electron: The app's shell: Chromium and Node. Ships.
packages.@electron/get: Electron's own downloader for its binaries, checked against the checksums in the electron package: used by electron's install step and by our packaging script. Build only.
packages.@electron-internal/extract-zip: Unpacks Electron's binary for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.sumchecker: Checks Electron's binary against the checksums in its package, for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.ms: Time formatting for debug. Build only.
packages.env-paths: Cache folder lookup for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.progress: Download progress bar for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.undici-types: Type declarations pulled in by @types/node. Build only.
packages.@types/node: Type declarations for Node (ours, and the copy Electron's own types ask for). Build only.
packages.@typescript/typescript-*: TypeScript's own program, one build per platform; only the one for this machine is installed. Build only.
packages.esbuild: The bundler for main, the preloads and the views. Build only.
packages.@esbuild/*: esbuild's own program, one build per platform; only the one for this machine is installed. Build only.
packages.@electron/fuses: Electron's own tool that sets the fuses in its binary. Build only.
packages.resedit: Writes a resource into a Windows program file (the app archive's hash, for Electron's integrity check). Build only.
packages.pe-library: Reads and writes Windows program files, for resedit. Build only.
packages.preact: The view library the screens are built with (plan B7). Ships.
packages.@fontsource/*: Open-licensed typefaces (OFL 1.1), font files only, no code: IBM Plex Sans Condensed and IBM Plex Mono, Berth's chosen type. Ships.

goModules.golang.org/x/crypto: The Go team's cryptography: Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305 for the locked list, and from step 2 on the SSH protocol itself (plan B2.1, B2.4). Ships.
goModules.golang.org/x/sys: The Go team's operating-system calls: processor feature detection for x/crypto. Ships.
